svg.title: Mangrove Channels — Woven mangrove crossings
svg.desc: Open root clearings separate skitter pockets. Bound root bridges, work baskets and a canopy shed make the climb; visible channels keep creature silhouettes readable. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops
